mapper.select: SELECT `id`,`tenant_id`,`device_id`,`contract_id`,`device_sn`,`contract_no`,`contract_type`,`product_code`,`product_model`,`license_status`,`creator`,`updater`,`create_time`,`update_time`,`deleted`,`license_code_ciphertext`,`license_code` FROM ast_device_license_record WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND id IN #{id}AND 1=0FOR UPDATE

SELECT d.id,requests.requested_sn FROM ast_device d JOIN (VALUES ROW(#{sn})SELECT '' AS requested_sn WHERE 1=0) requests(requested_sn) ON d.sn=requests.requested_sn COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND CAST(d.sn AS BINARY)=CAST(requests.requested_sn AS BINARY) WHERE d.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND d.deleted=FALSE FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ast_device_license_record r JOIN (VALUES ROW(#{row.target.id},#{row.target.deviceId})) requested(license_id,device_id) ON requested.license_id=r.id JOIN ast_device d ON d.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND d.id=requested.device_id AND d.deleted=FALSE AND CAST(d.sn AS BINARY)=CAST(r.device_sn AS BINARY) SET r.device_id=d.id,r.update_time=r.update_time WHERE r.tenant_id=#{context.tenantId} AND r.deleted=FALSE AND r.device_id IS NULL
